nodes.summary: Representing integers as sums from special sets, and the density of integer sets: sumsets of integers, subset sums and complete sequences, primitive sets, natural and logarithmic density, Romanoff's theorem; additive bases and complements and zero-sum constants go to additive combinatorics.
nodes.title: Additive number theory

nodes.summary: Number fields and rings of integers: quadratic and cyclotomic fields, discriminants, ramification, ideals, adeles and ideles, class field theory.
nodes.title: Algebraic number theory

nodes.summary: Divisor sums, totients, Möbius and multiplicative functions, their mean values and extremal orders, and integers classified by them.
nodes.title: Arithmetic functions

nodes.summary: Rational points of varieties over number fields: torsion and rank of elliptic curves, naive heights, Hasse principle, local-global failures.
nodes.title: Arithmetic geometry

nodes.summary: Modular arithmetic: Wilson, Wolstenholme and Fermat-quotient congruences, lifting the exponent, primitive roots, Legendre/Jacobi symbols, reciprocity, covering systems.
nodes.title: Congruences and power residues

nodes.summary: Continued fractions, Farey sequences, Stern–Brocot tree, Engel, Pierce, Lüroth and similar series expansions of real numbers.
nodes.title: Continued fractions and expansions of reals

nodes.summary: Base-b digits of integers, repdigits and palindromes, Kaprekar and happy numbers, Zeckendorf and base-φ systems, automatic sequences.
nodes.title: Digits and numeration systems

nodes.summary: Approximating reals by rationals or algebraics, Roth and subspace theorems, linear forms in logarithms, transcendence, uniform distribution, geometry of numbers.
nodes.title: Diophantine approximation and transcendence

nodes.summary: Integer and rational solutions of polynomial and exponential equations, Pell equations, Thue equations, Diophantine tuples, Egyptian fractions.
nodes.title: Diophantine equations

nodes.summary: Counting primes: prime number theorem, explicit Chebyshev-type bounds, prime gaps and short intervals, primes in progressions, sieves, prime patterns.
nodes.title: Distribution of primes

nodes.summary: Gauss sums, Weyl and Vinogradov sums, incomplete exponential sums, Burgess bounds, Dirichlet polynomials, trigonometric and cotangent sums.
nodes.title: Exponential and character sums

nodes.summary: Number-theoretic analogues over F_q[T] and finite fields: polynomial primes, h-free polynomials, function-field adeles, positive-characteristic zeta values.
nodes.title: Arithmetic of function fields

nodes.summary: Absolute heights of algebraic numbers, Mahler measure, Lehmer's problem, Dobrowolski bounds, Schinzel–Zassenhaus, house and trace problems.
nodes.title: Heights and Mahler measure

nodes.summary: Named nonlinear integer sequences: Collatz and iterated maps, self-referential sequences, Sylvester and Euclid sequences, realizable and Dold sequences.
nodes.title: Integer sequences

nodes.summary: Fibonacci, Lucas, Pell, Tribonacci and other linear recurrences: identities, divisibility, periods, primitive divisors and Diophantine properties.
nodes.title: Linear recurrence sequences

nodes.summary: Modular forms and functions, congruence subgroups, Ramanujan tau, theta functions, mock theta functions, Lambert series, partition congruences.
nodes.title: Modular forms, q-series and partitions

nodes.summary: Sylvester's coin theorem, Frobenius numbers, pseudo-Frobenius sets and numerical semigroups generated by special sequences.
nodes.title: Numerical semigroups and the Frobenius problem

nodes.summary: p-adic integers and expansions, valuations of integer sequences, Hensel lifting, Strassmann's theorem, Hilbert symbols, p-adic gamma, local fields.
nodes.title: p-adic numbers and local fields

nodes.summary: Individual primes and prime tests: special prime families, primality criteria, pseudoprimes, Carmichael numbers, Fermat and Mersenne numbers.
nodes.title: Primes and primality

nodes.summary: Representations by quadratic forms: sums of two, three and four squares, binary forms and class numbers, universality theorems, Waring's problem.
nodes.title: Quadratic forms and sums of squares

nodes.summary: Arithmetic of classical number families: Bernoulli, Euler and Genocchi numbers, harmonic numbers, binomial and Catalan-type coefficients.
nodes.title: Special numbers and polynomials

nodes.summary: Riemann zeta and xi, Dirichlet characters and L-functions, Dedekind and Artin L-functions, Riemann hypothesis criteria, multiple zeta values.
nodes.title: Zeta and L-functions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
